# Last Actor task run's log

The API endpoint described in this section is convenience endpoint that provides access to last Actor task run's log.

Same as of functionality described in: [Logs](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/logs.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get last Actor task run's log](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-last-log-get.md)

[/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/log](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-task-last-log-get.md)
